title: Russell US Style indexes — conditional quarter-end capping check effective at the open of 2027-09-30 (24% / 4.8%-above-48% test struck on the 2027-09-27 close), the family's control quarter: no reconstitution in the window and no reading of the owner's documents in dispute
source: EST: owner-published standing rule, both governing documents re-fetched and re-extracted first-hand by this event's own initial research (2026-09-09) rather than inherited from the proposal that carried this id. FTSE Russell, "Capping Methodology Guide", v5.4, September 2026 (lseg.com dam policy-documents, capping-methodology-guide.pdf, HTTP 200, 652,008 bytes, 62 content streams inflated and text-extracted in-session — the identical byte and stream counts five siblings recorded, which is the check that this is the same edition), section 4.8.6: every Russell US Style row reads frequency "Monthly", price date "T-3", effective date "Last business day of each month", trigger "No company is greater than 24%, and all companies that have a weight greater than 4.8% in aggregate are no more than 48% of the index", scheme "Rule 4.2/RIC 22.5/45", footnote 3 carrying the June-reconstitution exemption that is inapplicable to September by construction. FTSE Russell, "Frequently Asked Questions — Russell US Equity Indexes", July 2026 (ftse-faq-document-russell-us-equity-2026.pdf, HTTP 200, 198,134 bytes, 19 streams), whose schedule table was read at the column level this session and publishes, for September 2026: lock-down open 7 September, style capping cut-off 9 September, review effective open 21 September, quarter-end capping cut-off 25 September, quarter-end capping effective open 30 September. THE ARITHMETIC, re-derived here and not taken on faith: the last business day of September 2027 is Thursday 2027-09-30, and September 2027 carries exactly one NYSE closure — Labor Day, Monday 2027-09-06 — read direct from nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars this session (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes; its 2027 column reads "Labor Day | Monday, September 6" with no other September row and no early close) and reproduced independently from this repo's own src/domain/market-calendar.ts. So T-3 counts back 09-29, 09-28, 09-27 with no holiday step, striking the test on the close of Monday 2027-09-27. The same trading-day rule reproduces all four of the owner's published 2026 quarter-end cut-offs to the day (26 March, 25 June, 25 September, 28 December) from the FAQ column read here. Filed estimate on the four counts this family always records: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, the confirmed-tier prefixes in market-events-data.ts have no member for an index owner's own published methodology, the FAQ's dated table carries 2026 columns only and closes "NOTE: Dates may be subject to change", and the two owner documents still disagree on the check's frequency. THE FREQUENCY CONFLICT CANNOT REACH THIS INSTANCE: the guide's "Monthly / last business day of each month" reading and the FAQ's "conducted quarterly (March, June, September, and December)" reading name the SAME date and the SAME T-3 price date for September, so this entry needs no position on the dispute. Conditional by construction — the FAQ says "If no breach is identified, no changes are made." Canonical file written 2026-09-09 by this event's initial research, after reading the one proposal carrying this id (proposals/russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-09-30.from-russell-style-quarter-end-capping-effective-2027-12-31.json)
notes: THIS IS THE FAMILY'S CONTROL QUARTER, and that is the reason to keep it rather than a reason to trade it. Six instances of this rule are now tracked (2026-09-30, 2026-12-31, 2027-03-31, 2027-06-30, 2027-09-30, 2027-12-31) against ZERO observed firings, and September 2027 is the cleanest of the six on three counts settled by document rather than by argument. (1) NO DISPUTED READING TOUCHES IT — the guide's monthly reading and the FAQ's quarterly reading name the same 09-30 effective date and the same 09-27 price date. (2) THE INDEX EVENT INSIDE THE WINDOW IS THE REDUCED ONE — every instance of this family has the review that strikes its reset implementing INSIDE the cut-off-to-test window, so no quarter is assumption-free; but September's is the quarterly review (IPO adds from the 1 May-31 July window, buffered shares-in-issue and free-float updates, and the style capping recap itself, per the russell-quarterly-ipo-review-effective-2027-03-22 lane's own correction of the 2026-09-21 sibling), which is a STRICT SUBSET of what December's reconstitution additionally carries (full total market cap, nationality, shares outstanding, and R1000/R2000 cap-tier migration). The December 2027 sibling had to argue Appendix F's reduced-scope table to defend its 18-session window; this one does not need that argument. (3) EVERY DATE INPUT IS CORROBORATED BY SOMETHING THIS CALENDAR ALREADY TRACKS AS CONFIRMED — the review's implementation Friday 2027-09-17 is opex-2027-09-17 (confirmed, OCC:), and the Fed's own calendar page (federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm, fetched direct 2026-09-09) names 2027-09-15, matching this calendar's fomc-2027-09-15. THE TEMPTING CONDITIONAL IS DEAD, AND IT IS RECORDED HERE SO NOBODY REDISCOVERS IT ALONE. September's 13-session drift window (09-08 cut-off to the 09-27 test, counted through src/domain/market-calendar.ts) is the only instance in the family that contains BOTH the quarter's FOMC decision and a quarterly triple witching, so the natural question is whether either re-prices the base rate. The raw answer is loud and wrong: over 1,254 daily bars (2021-09-09 to 2026-09-08), 13-session windows containing a quarterly witching breach in 2 of 259 (0.77%) against 52 of 982 (5.30%) elsewhere. It does not survive its control. The 54 breaching windows come from only 20 distinct episodes, the entire witching cell is ONE of those episodes (March 2023), and a block permutation relocating the same 19 witching anchors uniformly returns p = 0.075. The FOMC cut is a plain null (17/556 = 3.06% vs 37/685 = 5.40%, permutation p = 0.24). Use the unconditional 54/1,241 = 4.35%. Impact low and symbols deliberately EMPTY on this family's standing measured grounds, re-verified this session: no house playbook is index-flow-keyed (docs/plans/trade-playbooks.md and docs/research/multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped for rebalanc|reconstitution|russell|capping|index.flow|IWF|IWY, zero hits in both), a fired recap moves roughly $475M across five of the most liquid names on the tape, and an ETF proxy in symbols would make the deterministic screen trip on mega-cap beta rather than on anything about this event. Conditional and historically it has never been observed to fire; nothing here licenses an entry.
